cases.question: Can I join all customer identities to orders to report revenue?
cases.answer: Do not join every customer identity row to orders on canonical customer ID and then sum revenue. The identity table has multiple rows for 25,538 resolved customers, up to five per customer, so that join can multiply order amounts. Aggregate revenue at its fact grain first; join a unique customer dimension for customer attributes, or use a deduplicated canonical-ID set/EXISTS for identity filtering. If resolving source customer IDs, join on source system plus source customer ID and validate mapping uniqueness and unmatched records.
